text: 天眼查App显示，11月2日，绿地控股集团有限公司等新增1则被执行人信息，执行标的8.1亿余元人民币，执行法院为江苏省南京市中级人民法院。该公司成立于1992年7月，法定代表人为张玉良，注册资本约226.5亿人民币，经营范围为实业投资，绿化，仓储，房地产，出租汽车，日用百货，纺织品，物业管理，化工产品，建材，五金交电，建筑施工，由绿地控股集团股份有限公司、绿地金创科技集团有限公司共同持股。（界面）
text_en: Tianyancha App shows that on November 2, Greenland Holding Group Co., Ltd. and others added one piece of information as persons subject to enforcement, with an enforcement amount of more than 810 million yuan, and the enforcement court is the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province. The company was established in July 1992, with Zhang Yuliang as its legal representative and registered capital of approximately 22.65 billion yuan. Its business scope covers industrial investment, greening, warehousing, real estate, taxis, daily necessities, textiles, property management, chemical products, building materials, hardware and electrical appliances, and construction. It is jointly held by Greenland Holdings Group Co., Ltd. and Greenland JINCHUANG Technology Group Co., Ltd. (Jiemian)
